frames.title: auto_focus
frames.status: invalid native aperture or extraction catalogue

photometry_scope: Native fixed circular aperture of one image FWHM radius, 5x5 subpixel area samples, local median annulus at 1.8–2.8 radii, BPM=0. Each exposure is calibrated against matched PS1 r PSF magnitudes, fitting the optical color term with a pivot at g-i=0.7; the transient color is unknown. The epoch value is a weighted average with errors from common blank apertures. The five-scatter depth is an empirical sensitivity in a single band and time window. The 95% recovery estimate adds fixed-aperture flux to measured control residuals at fixed weights. It does not include mismatched source profiles, color corrections for an unknown transient spectrum, or calibration correlated across frames.
